address: 89 Soi Charat Wiang, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok, 10500, Thailand
bio: With a history spanning more than half a century, what started as a food stall located in a small alley has since grown into a popular and bustling neighbourhood restaurant. They specialise in Cantonese cuisine, and their roast duck and signature sauces are highly recommended, especially paired with Cantonese-style noodles. The menu also features a deliciously tender clay pot-braised beef....
